evidence.evidence_text: Retrieval-Augmented Machine Translation (RAMT) is attracting growing attention.
This model adapts a retrieval-augmented version of the Levenshtein Transformer and makes it amenable to simultaneously edit multiple fuzzy matches found in memory.
